rationale: Exact semantic equivalence describing standard credential login.

label: possible duplicate

label: possible duplicate
rationale: Identical functional capability with minor vocabulary variation.

rationale: Account lockout threshold and trigger are identical.

label: possible duplicate
rationale: Identical set of supported localized languages.

text_b: The system shall not store unencrypted customer credit card details in the persistent database.
label: related but different
rationale: Hard negative: Crucial negation flip reverses obligation and security posture.

rationale: Hard negative: 'never allow' vs 'allow' represents direct opposition.

label: related but different
rationale: Hard negative: Privileged administrator role vs standard operator role.

label: related but different
rationale: Hard negative: View permission vs modify permission; patient vs doctor.

label: related but different
rationale: Hard negative: Radically different SLA timeframe (24 hours vs 30 days).

text_a: Session timeout shall automatically occur after 15 minutes of user inactivity.

label: related but different
rationale: Hard negative: High-security 15 min timeout vs persistent 24 hour session.

rationale: Password recovery workflow vs active login authentication workflow.

rationale: Tax calculation vs coupon discount logic in the same checkout module.
